title: mut.swap_object_model
mutation_directive: If the parent loads a 3D model and samples its surface as a point cloud (PLYLoader / GLTFLoader + MeshSurfaceSampler), swap the loaded model to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/main/Models/MosquitoInAmber/glTF-Binary/MosquitoInAmber.glb (mosquito-in-amber fossil — preserved insect). Use the URL exactly as given. If the URL ends in .glb or .gltf, use GLTFLoader and traverse the scene for the first mesh whose geometry has position attribute, then build the sampler from that geometry. Re-normalize the bounding box to fit the existing camera framing. Keep the rest of the piece (palette, gestures, animation) intact. If the parent does NOT use a model loader, instead introduce one: load the model URL and replace the procedural particle distribution with a 60k surface sampling of the loaded mesh.
